tags.instructions: Get userId and role from `list-users` or `get-user`; the invitation must be accepted. Names/email may change only for the connection's key owner. Email changes require that user's current password. Administrators may replace other non-admin users' company access. Omitted fields stay unchanged; companyIds replaces the whole access list. Passwords and roles cannot be changed here.
